name: Yumikawa Cross
source:
Cross makes up the other half of the Nakano Symphonies. He’s quite knowledgeable, and is a rather talented hacker. What’s more, his excellent information-gathering and analysis skills allow him to relay valuable, real-time information to Pollon on the field.

As the older of the duo, Cross acts as a supportive big brother to Pollon.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
